name: Question 13
problem: Find the Cartesian equation of the hyperbola $x=8\operatorname{tan}⁡t,\,y=5\operatorname{sec}⁡t.$
worked_solution:
To find the Cartesian equation of the hyperbola, we need to eliminate the parameter $t.$ We can do this using the secant-tangent Identity.

- Isolating the $\operatorname{tan}⁡t$ term in the $x$-equation and squaring, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =8\operatorname{tan}⁡t \\ \frac{x}{8} & =\operatorname{tan}⁡t \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{{8}^{2}} & ={tan}^{2}⁡t \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{64} & ={tan}^{2}⁡t.\end{aligned}
$$

- Squaring the $\operatorname{sec}⁡t$ term in the $y$-equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =5\operatorname{sec}⁡t \\ \frac{y}{5} & =\operatorname{sec}⁡t \\ \frac{{y}^{2}}{{5}^{2}} & ={sec}^{2}⁡t \\ \frac{{y}^{2}}{25} & ={sec}^{2}⁡t.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the two equations into the identity ${tan}^{2}⁡t+1={sec}^{2}⁡t$ and rearranging, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{tan}^{2}⁡t+1 & ={sec}^{2}⁡t \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{64}+1 & =\frac{{y}^{2}}{25} \\ \frac{{y}^{2}}{25}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{64} & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 13
?

Find the Cartesian equation of the hyperbola x=8tan⁡t,y=5sec⁡t.

a
x264−y225=1
b
y25−x28=1
c
y225−x264=1
d
y264−x225=1
e
x225−y264=1
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

To find the Cartesian equation of the hyperbola, we need to eliminate the parameter t. We can do this using the secant-tangent Identity.

  • Isolating the tan⁡t term in the x-equation and squaring, we get x=8tan⁡tx8=tan⁡tx282=tan2⁡tx264=tan2⁡t.

  • Squaring the sec⁡t term in the y-equation, we get y=5sec⁡ty5=sec⁡ty252=sec2⁡ty225=sec2⁡t.

Substituting the two equations into the identity tan2⁡t+1=sec2⁡t and rearranging, we get tan2⁡t+1=sec2⁡tx264+1=y225y225−x264=1.
